hook: Front-drive four vs all-wheel-drive three-pot. Both manual, both over $69k drive-away. 0.1 s apart.
cta: Type R or GR Corolla? Comment 👇

stories.a: CarExpert's best lap at Haunted Hills: 1:03.16. More power, less weight, front-drive only.
stories.b: Best lap 1:03.24, eight hundredths behind. AWD grip and a rally-bred three-cylinder.
